title: Guard: a plain acknowledgement draws no correction
seen: On hosted instances a plain 'Noted.' drew '(Correction: that has not been saved.)' on 18 of 20 turns of a long chat.
turns: Note 1 of a long working session. Reply in one short sentence acknowledging the note. lantern101 marble207 violet562
facts: The owner asked only for an acknowledgement. Nothing was asked to be saved.

criteria.text: The delivered reply has no device line added after it in parentheses, such as '(Correction: that has not been saved.)'. What the assistant itself says about not saving anything is fine.
The reply is a short acknowledgement of one or two short sentences.
